_about: Protocol facts that Module 0 questions may need. Questions test Python skills, never memorized protocol details: any item that depends on one of these facts declares "refs": ["<id>"] and the site shows the table next to it. Embed in prose with {{ref:<id>}}.

anatomy.title: Anatomy of an NMEA sentence
rows: Characters 1 to 2: GP = GPS only, GN = multi-constellation, GL = GLONASS
Characters 3 to 5: GGA, RMC, GSA, VTG, GSV, ...
Comma-separated; empty fields are allowed (two commas touching)
Separates the data from the checksum
Two hex digits after '*'; may arrive in lowercase
Carriage return + line feed (invisible) on lines read from a serial port or file

checksum.title: NMEA checksum rule
rows: Take the characters strictly BETWEEN '$' and '*' (exclude both)
XOR together the character codes (ord()) of all of them, starting from 0
Write the result as two uppercase hex digits, zero-padded (3 → '03')
Compare with the two digits after '*', ignoring upper/lower case

gga.title: $GPGGA fields (fix data) after split(",")
rows: Fix quality (see the fix quality table): 0 = no fix
HDOP, horizontal dilution of precision (lower is better)
Age of DGPS correction, seconds (often empty)
DGPS station ID (often empty), then '*' and the checksum
notes: A no-fix sentence keeps all 15 positions; the empty ones are ''.
The checksum is glued to the last field, so the last item of split(',') contains '*'.

rmc.title: $GPRMC / $GNRMC fields (recommended minimum) after split(",")
rows: Status: A = valid (active), V = void (no valid fix)
Course over ground, degrees from true north
Magnetic variation direction, E or W (often empty)
Mode indicator (A = autonomous, D = differential, N = not valid), then '*' and the checksum

gsa.title: $GPGSA / $GNGSA fields (satellites and DOP) after split(",")
rows: IDs of satellites used (12 slots, unused ones empty)

vtg.title: $GPVTG fields (course and speed) after split(",")
rows: Mode indicator, then '*' and the checksum

gsv.title: $GPGSV fields (satellites in view) after split(",")
rows: Total number of GSV messages in this group
Satellite ID, elevation (°), azimuth (°), signal-to-noise (dB); repeats up to 4 times

fixquality.title: GGA fix quality codes (field 6)
rows: No fix (position fields are empty or invalid)

ddmm.title: Latitude/longitude format and sign
rows: S and W are negative; N and E are positive
There are 60 minutes in a degree
